# GrowthLab

> GrowthLab is a local-first AI growth experiment workbench that turns ambiguous growth questions into structured, editable, testable, and exportable experiment plans.

GrowthLab helps product managers, growth teams, experimentation teams, indie hackers, and marketers design growth experiments and plan A/B tests. The interface is currently in Simplified Chinese. A complete demo works without an account or AI provider.

## What GrowthLab does

- Structures an experiment across problem analysis, hypotheses, design, audience, metrics, sample size, copy, risks, decision rules, launch checks, and retrospective.
- Connects to user-provided OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible model endpoints.
- Parses model output as JSON and validates it with Zod.
- Estimates sample size for two independent proportions, including one- or two-sided tests, unequal allocation, and multiple variants.
- Stores projects locally in the browser and supports Markdown and JSON export.

## Key facts

- Product type: browser-based growth experiment and A/B testing planner.
- Primary audience: product, growth, experimentation, data, and marketing teams.
- Deployment: static web application hosted on GitHub Pages.
- Data model: local-first; projects are stored in browser localStorage.
- AI credentials: API keys stay in memory and sessionStorage and are excluded from projects and exports.
- Pricing: the app and demo are free; configured model providers may charge separately.
